flows.name: create_or_plan_task
steps: create Local Task or reference accepted WFM Task identity
accept or leave absent the operational Task plan
if created from an Objective envelope, initialize Task plan once from that envelope then treat it as an independent Task fact
persist Task unscheduled when no complete accepted interval exists
when schedulable, evaluate grouping proposal against all eligible Tasks

flows.name: group_tasks
steps: select eligible Tasks with accepted positive-duration intervals
build global strict-overlap connected components transitively
keep exact-touch intervals separate unless separately reviewed together
derive proposed Objective envelope from min Task start and max Task end
surface Customer/RFC/multi-context only as explanatory warnings/partitions
if bridging work intersects existing Objectives, propose consolidation instead of accepting overlap
accept regroup only after revision/lock/non-overlap revalidation in one atomic commit

flows.name: reconcile_wfm_plan
steps: receive immutable provider source-plan evidence from HLD-05
compare with accepted operational Task plan
review choices: adopt source, retain manual plan with reason, correct, or remain unresolved
recompute Objective grouping/envelope proposal only when current history/locks permit
never alter actual execution chronology from source-plan changes

flows.name: execute_and_review
steps: Objective may enter In-Progress without starting every Task
start/cancel/complete each Task independently and record actual chronology
derive due/review queue from accepted execution state without fabricating outcome
review individual Task outcome and record reviewed_at separately from execution times
derive Objective aggregate state/outcome from member Task facts
publish reviewed physical-consequence inputs to Inventory only when explicitly established

flows.name: correct_or_retry
steps: correction targets existing attempt/history and appends new interpretation/evidence
retry creates a new Task identity linked to predecessor
retry scheduling re-enters normal grouping rules
prior attempt identity, outcome and Objective ancestry remain preserved

flows.name: terminal_rfc_effect
steps: consume separately confirmed RFC cascade consequences from HLD-04
remove/cancel only the applicable active WFM executable work defined by that cascade
preserve unrelated Local Tasks and unaffected Objective work
if In-Progress Objective retains executable Tasks, continue with warning
if none remain, project Incomplete — Awaiting Review rather than auto-completing/cancelling
preserve all prior Task/Objective history

flows.name: historical_structure
steps: provider Complete plus valid accepted source plan may create a historical-Objective proposal
review structure without claiming execution/outcome/Inventory facts
without a usable interval retain terminal unassigned Task history
optional operational-count exclusion changes only reporting projection and discloses included/excluded populations
